reason: The text describes divine intervention leading to the ultimate triumph of the Israelites over their enemies, the Egyptians. This includes God's actions to strengthen Pharaoh's heart so that he pursues the Israelites into the Red Sea, only for the waters to close upon them, resulting in their destruction. This narrative clearly illustrates divine foresight and judgment, as well as an eschatological theme of good (Israelites) overcoming evil (Egyptians).
story: The Parting of the Red Sea
